manifest.draw_order: row-major: six consecutive PCG64 uniform draws per state, in physical-state order
manifest.role: qualification/development; never independent held-out learned-policy evaluation

full_study_decisions.separation_comparison: exact rational values of submitted binary64 thrusts; normalized L-infinity; pairwise among credited actions
full_study_decisions.comparator: strongest tested matched classical baseline; MPC80-only oracle results do not settle that requirement

first_query_parity: archive state/observation/reference/initial guesses/primal/dual/parameters/action and post-query x/u plan; exact numerical arrays, timings excluded
initialization: native factory ordering; controller factory already resets controller; then native plant reset exactly once
controller_memory: preserve nominal post-query x_prev/u_prev/prev_action/optimizer state; no in-place mutation of returned action view
candidate_contract: candidate-specific request and current raw/cache context; no future states used to construct bound

alternative.selection_rule: ID 0 first lexicographic nonzero, nonduplicate, source-input-admissible item with exact submitted-thrust separation >=1/20; no future safety/return selection
alternative.substitution: detached request; one interval only; native MPC continuation retains nominal first-query memory

pilot_go: separate execution approval and CPU extension; zero-offset pair and both replays pass before alternative pair; reserve every job; stop on first pilot acceptance/integrity/resource failure; no retries or fallback
limitations: mocked state rows are archived lookups not integrated candidate trajectories
technical pilot cannot pass 3-of-4 diversity or strongest-baseline headroom criteria
